applies_to.notes: Default superuser in all branches. Verified against the documentation: 1.8, 2.0, 2.2, 2.4, 3.0, 4.0, 5.0, 6.0, 7.0, 7.2, 7.4 (current), 8.0 (in 7.0 the section moved to manual/quickstart/basic_config/login). No anomalies across branches 3.0-7.2.

notes: Official installer default: 'Enter the user name Admin with password zabbix to log in as a Zabbix superuser'. The password should be changed immediately (recommended in all branches). Branch links: /3.0, /4.0, /5.0, /6.0, /7.2 — the same text.

applies_to.notes: user.login works with the same credentials. Login parameter name: ≤5.2 — 'user', from 5.4 — 'username' (in 6.0 'user' is deprecated, removed from the documentation in 7.0). IMPORTANT: the task statement said the opposite ('7.0+ requires user instead of username') — the fact was verified against the documentation of each branch, see the notes_file.

notes: JSON-RPC 2.0, POST to <host>/zabbix/api_jsonrpc.php. ≤5.2: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"user.login","params":{"user":"Admin","password":"zabbix"},"id":1}. 5.4+: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"user.login","params":{"username":"Admin","password":"zabbix"},"id":1}. Optionally params.userData=true (6.0+). Response: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":"<sessionid>","id":1}. The method is called WITHOUT the auth parameter.

applies_to.notes: guest is enabled and accessible WITHOUT a password: 2.x and 3.0 — 'you may access monitoring pages without being logged in'; from 4.0.15 disabled by default ('add it to the Guests user group to re-enable'); until 6.0.28 automatic guest login was possible; 6.0/7.0/7.2 — 'disabled by default', in 7.0+ remove the 'Disabled' group to enable.

notes: guest is a special preinstalled user without a password and (by default) WITHOUT permissions on Zabbix objects ('by default guest has no permissions on Zabbix objects') — applies to both the web and the API. Even when enabled, without assigned permissions via the Guests group it sees nothing. The password is empty (the password field is not filled).

applies_to.notes: Default zabbix-docker env: POSTGRES_USER/POSTGRES_PASSWORD = zabbix/zabbix; MYSQL_USER/MYSQL_PASSWORD = zabbix/zabbix; POSTGRES_DB/MYSQL_DATABASE = zabbix; DB_SERVER_HOST defaults to 'postgres-server'/'mysql-server'. Verified in the 6.0, 7.0, 7.4(HEAD) branches of the repository and in the official container documentation 5.0/current.

notes: Values are set via env_file/secrets (env_vars/.env_db_mysql, .env_db_pgsql); the defaults are commented out as zabbix/zabbix. Official documentation: 'MYSQL_USER ... By default, value is zabbix', 'MYSQL_PASSWORD ... By default, value is zabbix' (and the same for POSTGRES_*) — https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/5.0/en/manual/installation/containers. The current documentation suggests replacing the password with a strong one (POSTGRES_PASSWORD=zabbix_pwd), but the image default is zabbix.

applies_to.notes: The default Zabbix DB user is 'zabbix'. In a docker deployment (zabbix-server-mysql/pgsql, zabbix-web-*) the default image password is 'zabbix'. When installing from packages/source, the documentation requires creating the 'zabbix' user with A PASSWORD CHOSEN BY THE ADMINISTRATOR — there is no fixed default password for bare-metal.

notes: Container documentation: POSTGRES_USER/MYSQL_USER default 'zabbix', POSTGRES_PASSWORD/MYSQL_PASSWORD default 'zabbix'. MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD has no default (empty). These credentials are not used for the API/frontend — they are for the server/web DB connection string.

applies_to.notes: Default API tokens DO NOT exist. API authentication is either a session from user.login (Admin/zabbix) or an API token created by the user themselves (frontend Users > API tokens or the token API method).

notes: Informational record (not credentials): 'To access any data in Zabbix, you need to either: Use an existing API token created in the Zabbix frontend, Users > API tokens section, or created using the Token API. Use an authentication token obtained with the user.login method.' The token is passed in the auth field of JSON-RPC or via the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header.

notes: nuclei template zabbix-default-login: POST name/password to /index.php and /zabbix/index.php, matcher 302 → zabbix.php?action=dashboard.view.

applies_to.notes: The only zabbix entry in SecLists default-passwords.csv: 'zabbix,Admin,zabbix'. default-passwords.txt has only the password line 'zabbix' without a pair.

notes: The canonical default-credentials wordlist; there are NO other zabbix pairs in SecLists (admin/admin, zabbix/zabbix for the UI, etc.).

applies_to.notes: The Metasploit zabbix_login module tests the default Admin:zabbix login and guest mode availability ('Zabbix enables a Guest mode by default that allows access to the dashboard without auth').

notes: The 'Zabbix Server Brute Force Utility' module: with guest mode enabled it reports 'This Zabbix instance has Guest mode enabled'. Module comment: guest mode allows dashboard access without authentication.
